current.text: He was traded from Milwaukee to Miami.
He played basically as a point guard in Miami's first preseason game.
Miami lost a lot of depth and ball handlers in its trades.
With few other creators in Miami, he should handle the ball a lot, keep high usage and raise his assist rate.
He is expected to play 32 to 33 minutes in Miami, up from 29, unless he gets hurt again.
His fantasy value is safe and probably rises after the trade. The extra minutes may offset the usual first-year adjustment after a team change.
With more minutes and aggression his FG% could get back to 65%.
Experts see him as about the 5th pick in category leagues and say the market still undervalues him.
ESPN's category rank of 20 makes no sense to one expert. He says Giannis is at worst 9th.
In an auction mock draft he went for 58 USD, about where the expert thinks he should sit. The expert expected about 60 USD.
At least 15 of the games he missed last season came while the Bucks were tanking.
Experts disagree on his health risk this season. One does not expect 70 games. Others have only mild injury worry.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs, but only 10 games in the playoff weeks.
Miami's depth is poor, so a Giannis injury would end their season.

durable.text: He has elite FG% on high volume and leads the league in FG% impact.
He is a strong scorer and rebounder, with guard-like assists for a forward.
He is a bad free throw shooter on high volume, with the worst FT impact in the league.
His FT% will probably stay bad, though a random 70% season would not be crazy.
He makes few threes. He shot 33% from three last season on low volume.
Experts do not see him as a good shooter from three.
He turns the ball over a lot.
His steals and blocks have been declining steadily, and they may not come back.
Drafting him means building a punt FT% team. It does not mean punting threes too, because threes are easy to make up elsewhere.
Plain nine-cat rankings rate him too low because of his free throws. His real H2H impact is huge once you punt FT%.
He has a long injury history, with persistent knee problems and a calf injury last season.
His age is a concern for his health and games played.

note: Giannis is a top-5 category asset if you punt FT%. His FG%, points, rebounds and big-man assists carry a build that gives up FT% and turnovers. Expect to pay about 58 to 62 USD: he went for 58 USD in an expert auction mock, Yahoo's average cost is 58.8 USD and he went for 62 USD in our league last season. Ignore ESPN's 40 USD value and rank of 20, which experts call wrong. Early in the season, check that he plays 32 or more minutes as Miami's main ball handler, and watch his knee and calf, because Miami's thin roster gives no cover if he misses games.
